diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~31% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.064), which favours a robust combination.
